frequency_question: What proportion of multi-stage fiscal policy proposals complete the mandatory administrative pipeline (drafting, technical review, agenda placement, formal vote, and notification) within a 49-day calendar window?
membership_rule: Includes all formal agenda items submitted for fiscal rate amendments requiring subcommittee review and council ratification. Excludes emergency ordinance measures bypassing standard committee review.

provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 4 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 4 major recent council meeting cycles examined; total historical cycles exceed 50, but structural procedural timelines remain uniform.
known_gaps: Complex financial service definitions often require extended stakeholder consultation beyond standard physical minimums.
skeleton: Standard fiscal policy cycle: Law Committee review (14-21 days) + Fitment Committee report finalization (10-14 days) + Council meeting notice period (7-14 days) + Post-meeting notification drafting (7-10 days).
multiplier: Sequential dependency sum: minimum physical duration equals 38 days under compressed timelines, fitting within the 49-day window.
validity_reason: Procedural rules and statutory timelines governing the fiscal council's operations remain stable under current legislative frameworks.
